blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A legal counsel for Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on Tuesday expressed concern over the Supreme Court’s (SC) dismissal of the consolidated petitions for a writ of habeas corpus following the International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte, saying the move could be seen as a “guide” to future scenarios. Dela Rosa also faces an ICC warrant. The senator’s lawyer Israelito Torreon made the remark after the High Court voted 9-4 to deny the consolidated petitions filed by Duterte’s children—Sebastian, Veronica, and Paolo Duterte—on behalf of their father to challenge his March 2025 arrest and turn […]...
